message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity (approx.) |
|----------|------|--------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Nutmeg (optional) | pinch |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 cups (200 g) |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, drained) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |

**Notes**

- If you prefer a vegetarian version, replace the ground meat with sautéed mushrooms, spinach, zucchini, or eggplant.
- For a richer flavor, add a splash of red wine to the meat sauce while it simmers.
- Adjust the amount of cheese based on how cheesy you like your lasagna.

Enjoy cooking!
